craft_notes: Sthāyin: gift-of-attention (mind-strength as the teaching). Rows: row 2 (shines→praise). Close: praise (ever-praise: sadā carried). Rejected: 'intellect' for mind-strength — killed: mind-strength kept (dhī+bala as force, not faculty); 'shows the way' — killed: shines kept (bhāti as light, not guidance).

lines: By whose mind-strength the world shines Śiva's path to devotees,
him, attention-formed, stainless true guru — ever praise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yaddhībalena viśvaṃ bhaktānāṃ śivapathaṃ bhāti | tamahamavadhānarūpaṃ sadgurumamalaṃ sadā vande

reads_against.argmap: Who gives understanding? → The Sadguru gives intellectual strength (avadhāna) by which the world shines as Śiva-path — Dyczkowski's śuddha-vidyā after long loving approach.
c1_essence: Sadguru's mind-strength makes the universe shine Śiva-pathed: attention itself the gift.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
